title: Well Pump Short-Cycle Health
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume / Flo / HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wellpump:event event=run
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_run
| eval gap_s=_time-prev_run
| stats count(eval(gap_s<60)) as short_cycles, count as runs
| eval short_cycle_pct=round(100*short_cycles/runs,1)
description: Detects a well pump switching on and off too rapidly, the short-cycling that burns out pumps and points to a failing pressure tank.
value: Short-cycling is the classic early symptom of a waterlogged pressure tank; catching it saves an expensive pump before it fails.
implementation: Ingest well-pump run events; schedule daily and flag a high proportion of rapid on-off cycles.
visualization: Single-value short-cycle percentage with run history.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when a well pump keeps switching on and off too quickly, which wears it out and needs fixing.
